validated_results.title: Gut microbiome and prostate cancer.
validated_results.journal: International journal of urology : official journal of the Japanese Urological Association
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review of gut microbiome links to prostate cancer that only speculates that "altering the gut microbiome using prebiotic or probiotic interventions may prevent or delay prostate cancer development," with no original human data.

validated_results.title: Can Diet Prevent Urological Cancers? An Update on Carotenoids as Chemopreventive Agents.
validated_results.reason: The paper explicitly states it "aims to review the current literature in regard to the effects of carotenoids in reducing urological cancer risk," so it is a review rather than an original study of beta-carotene.

validated_results.title: Can Diet Prevent Urological Cancers? An Update on Carotenoids as Chemopreventive Agents.
validated_results.reason: This carotenoid review reports no original human study estimate for zeaxanthin and incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: The Promising Therapeutic and Preventive Properties of Anthocyanidins/Anthocyanins on Prostate Cancer.
validated_results.reason: The abstract states the study "was designated to gather the preclinical and clinical studies" on anthocyanidins/anthocyanins for prostate cancer, making it a review rather than original research on pomegranate intake.

validated_results.title: Nutraceuticals and Phytotherapy in Men's Health: Antioxidants, Pro-oxidants, and a Novel Opportunity for Lifestyle Changes.
validated_results.journal: The Urologic clinics of North America
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review/commentary summarizing nutraceutical and phytotherapy trial evidence in men's health without original antioxidant–prostate cancer incidence data.

validated_results.title: The Cooked Meat Carcinogen 2-Amino-1-methyl-6-phenylimidazo[4,5-b]pyridine Hair Dosimeter, DNA Adductomics Discovery, and Associations with Prostate Cancer Pathology Biomarkers.
validated_results.reason: The study measures PhIP hair levels and DNA adducts in relation to "prostate pathology biomarkers" such as PSA and Gleason score in already-diagnosed patients, providing no evidence on developing prostate cancer from red meat intake.

validated_results.title: SIRT1 inhibition-induced senescence as a strategy to prevent prostate cancer progression.
validated_results.reason: Resveratrol-mediated SIRT1 activation was examined only in the "Pten-/- mouse model" and orthotopic cell-line implantation experiments, so the evidence is exclusively preclinical.

validated_results.title: Intake Patterns of Specific Alcoholic Beverages by Prostate Cancer Status.
validated_results.reason: This "cross-sectional study" models alcoholic beverage intake patterns as the outcome by existing prostate cancer status and aggressiveness, providing no incidence estimate.

validated_results.title: Cancer Burden in China during 1990-2019: Analysis of the Global Burden of Disease.
validated_results.reason: Alcohol is mentioned only incidentally among "main risk factors for cancer in China" in a descriptive Global Burden of Disease analysis, with no alcohol-specific prostate cancer incidence estimate.
